title: coap_rangetest.c: write-only s_initialized flag is dead code with drift risk
description: coap_rangetest.c:37 :672 sets s_initialized, never reads it - violates repo No-Dead-Code rule; sibling coap_msg.c:171-176 checks the analogous flag and fails -ENODEV closed. Fix: either check it in handlers/update (fail-closed like coap_msg) or delete it.
close_reason: Deleted s_initialized (decl :41, write at :676 pre-edit numbering) rather than fail-closing: coap_msg.c fails closed (:170/:221) because its handlers need lichen_msg_init() state, but rangetest is documented to serve static defaults with no provider (Kconfig help; metrics_get/hops_get/time_now all NULL-check), so a fail-closed gate would break the supported no-init mode. Behavior-neutral removal; twister qemu_x86/atom 7/7 test cases passed (incl. 6/6 byte-exact vectors). Commit <code>.
